task_description: The script analyzes long-term changes in water and land extent in Patuakhali, Bangladesh, using Landsat surface reflectance data from 2000 to 2021. It computes NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) for Landsat 5, 7, and 8 imagery, applies cloud and shadow masking using pixel_qa bands, and generates binary water and non-water masks based on NDWI thresholds. The script then calculates the frequency of water presence and absence over time, computes a net erosion-accretion index as the normalized difference between water and non-water occurrence frequencies, and outputs a clipped raster map showing spatial patterns of erosion (negative values) and accretion (positive values) with a red-white-green color scheme.
